productOnPage.title: I Dream of You Collection (Pack)
productOnPage.author: JJ Heller
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: A collection of 4 cards from singer/songwriter JJ Heller, full of serene melodies and cover versions of iconic songs.  Whether you’re looking for music for bedtime, car rides, chores around the house, or the sound track for life’s ordinary moments, JJ Heller has an I Dream of You album for it! JJ Heller’s orchestral I Dream of You albums are themed collections of songs chosen especially for families.I Dream of You: SLEEP, and CALM are for quiet moments and bedtimes, while FRIENDSHIP and JOY are meant playtimes and daily activities. Tracks included: Beautiful Day Do-Re-Mi The Bare Necessities Rainbow Connection Don't Worry, Be Happy Grand Adventure Friday I'm In Love I Can See Clearly A Spoonful Of Sugar Wildflowers Singin' In The Rain All You Need Is Love Young At Heart Ordinary Days What A Wonderful World Tomorrow
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Whether you’re looking for music for bedtime, car rides, chores around the house, or the sound track for life’s ordinary moments, JJ Heller has an I Dream of You album for it! JJ Heller’s orchestral I Dream of You albums are themed collections of songs chosen especially for families.


I Dream of You: SLEEP, and CALM are for quiet moments and bedtimes, while FRIENDSHIP and JOY are meant playtimes and daily activities.
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: A collection of 4 cards from singer/songwriter JJ Heller, full of serene melodies and cover versions of iconic songs. ._**

Whether you’re looking for music for bedtime, car rides, chores around the house, or the sound track for life’s ordinary moments, JJ Heller has an I Dream of You album for it! JJ Heller’s orchestral I Dream of You albums are themed collections of songs chosen especially for families.  
  
  
  
  
I Dream of You: SLEEP, and CALM are for quiet moments and bedtimes, while FRIENDSHIP and JOY are meant playtimes and daily activities.

Tracks included:

*   Beautiful Day
*   Do-Re-Mi
*   The Bare Necessities
*   Rainbow Connection
*   Don't Worry, Be Happy
*   Grand Adventure
*   Friday I'm In Love
*   I Can See Clearly
*   A Spoonful Of Sugar
*   Wildflowers
*   Singin' In The Rain
*   All You Need Is Love
*   Young At Heart
*   Ordinary Days
*   What A Wonderful World
*   Tomorrow
